newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia tender for 150,000 T U.S. wheat detailed.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia tender for 150,000 T U.S. wheat detailed.

text.p: Tunisia on Thursday confirmed it launched a tender to purchase six lots of 25,000 tonnes each of wheat for August to October shipment, traders said.
The deadline for offers was Friday June 27 no later than 0830 GMT.
The wheat is to be payable under a GSM credit to Tunisia, they added.
25,000 tonnes 10-20 August HRW NR2 or NS/DNS NR2 or better
25,000 tonnes 20-31 Aug SRW NR2 or better
25,000 tonnes 01-10 Sept HRW NR2 or NS/DNS NR2 or better
25,000 tonnes 10-20 Sept SRW NR2 or better
25,000 tonnes 20-30 Sept HRW NR2 or NSIONS nr2 or better
25,000 tonnes 01-10 Oct SRW NR2 or better
